6.2.section: INVESTMENT OPPORTUNITIES AND STRATEGIES; PRINCIPAL RISK FACTORS (DERIVATIVE INSTRUMENTS RISK; WAREHOUSE INVESTMENT RISK)
6.2.value: Objectives: primary — consistent current income; secondary — capital preservation. 80% policy: under normal market conditions at least 80% of assets (net assets plus borrowings for investment purposes) in loans to companies ('corporate loans'), accessed through seven printed routes: (i) direct loans originated by non-bank lenders; (ii) notes/pass-through obligations on direct loans; (iii) asset-backed securities on pools of direct loans; (iv) companies and/or private investment funds (3(c)(1)/3(c)(7)) primarily holding direct loans; (v) high yield securities; (vi) bank loans; (vii) SPVs and/or joint ventures holding loans or credit-like securities. Printed limit: investments in 3(c)(1)/3(c)(7) hedge funds and private equity funds limited to no more than 15% of assets. Non-U.S. investments permitted; currency fluctuations 'intended to be hedged through the use of currency derivatives or other instruments.' Other instruments: preferred securities, convertible securities, derivatives (options, swaps, futures contracts, forward agreements, reverse repurchase agreements and other similar transactions) for hedging and investment purposes, ETFs and other investment companies, warrants/equity of borrowers, Warehouses (pre-CLO/CDO financing structures); use subject to Rule 18f-4 (VaR leverage limit / derivatives risk management program unless limited derivatives user). 6.3.value: Conflicts: dedicated 'CONFLICTS OF INTEREST' section — Investment Manager and affiliates advise other vehicles with similar strategies that may compete for opportunities and may co-invest; shareholders deemed to acknowledge/waive certain conflict claims; valuation conflict disclosed ('participation of the investment professionals of the Investment Manager in the Fund's valuation process could result in a conflict of interest as the Investment Management Fee is based on the value of the Fund's assets'). Co-investment order: NOT held as of this prospectus — risk factor 'FAILURE TO OBTAIN CO-INVESTMENT EXEMPTIVE RELIEF' states the Fund and Investment Manager 'may seek' Section 17(d) exemptive relief and 'There is no assurance that the Fund or the Investment Manager will receive such exemptive relief.'
